description:
Create a new exterior lighting load and sub-meter for the 4StoreyBuilding project. 

1. Create a Day Schedule named 'SiteLt-Sch' for dusk-to-dawn operation: ON (1.0) from 7 PM to 6 AM (hours 19-24 and 1-6), and OFF (0.0) otherwise.
2. Create a new Electric Meter named 'Ext Lighting Meter'.
3. Create an Exterior Lighting load named 'Parking & Facade Lts' with 4.5 kW power, assigned to your new schedule and meter.
4. Run the annual simulation and save the project.
